why: One level, R 16, origin 0, voxel 0.25 m, valid range [0.375, 3.625] m on each axis (local [1.5, 14.5] voxels). Texels are filled analytically from the plane z 2.0 m: a = |z_centre - 2.0| metres, rgb 0. Texel centres sit at 0.25 k + 0.125 m, so a trilinear sample at z between two centres on the same side of the plane is exactly 2.0 - z (h = |z - 2.0|), and between the centres 1.875 and 2.125 m it is the constant 0.125 m. Each ray is walked by the contract's rules: t from start, step clamp(h, 0.5 voxel, 4 voxel), hard hit only when h < 0.5 voxel while approaching, otherwise res = min(res, d / (tan_half max(t - y, 1e-4))) with y = h^2 / (2 ph) when ph < 1e19 and h < 2 ph, d = sqrt(h^2 - y^2); the final value is smoothstep(clamp(res, 0, 1)). max_steps is 32 throughout.

cases.name: parallel to the plane
cases.why: The ray stays at y 2.0 and z 1.25, inside the valid range, so level_at returns 0 for every sample. Texel centres 1.125 and 1.375 m hold a = 0.875 and 0.625, so h = 0.75 at z 1.25 for every x. Sample 1 (t 0.25, x 1.25, ph 1e20): approaching; h < 0.125 is false; y = 0 because ph is not below 1e19; d = 0.75; res = min(1, 0.75 / (0.5 x 0.25)) = min(1, 6) = 1. Then ph = 0.75 and the step is clamp(0.75, 0.125, 1.0) = 0.75, so t = 1.0 (x 2.0). Sample 2: h = 0.75 equals ph, so it is not approaching and never darkens. The step of 0.75 takes t to 1.75, beyond max_t 1.5, so the loop ends. res = 1, and smoothstep(1) = 1.

cases.name: toward the plane, blocked
cases.why: Hand walk along +z, z = 0.5 + t. t 0.25 (z 0.75): h = 1.25, ph 1e20, y 0, d 1.25, res = min(1, 1.25 / 0.125) = 1; step clamp(1.25, 0.125, 1.0) = 1.0, t 1.25. t 1.25 (z 1.75): h = 0.25 < ph, y = 0.0625 / 2.5 = 0.025, d = sqrt(0.0625 - 0.000625) = 0.248747, res = min(1, 0.248747 / (0.5 x 1.225)) = 0.406117; step 0.25, t 1.5. t 1.5 (z 2.0): the samples at 1.875 and 2.125 are both 0.125 m, so h = 0.125; the hard hit needs h < 0.125, which is false, so no hit. Approaching (0.125 < 0.25): y = 0.015625 / 0.5 = 0.03125, d = sqrt(0.015625 - 0.00097656) = sqrt(15) / 32 = 0.121031, res = min(0.406117, 0.121031 / (0.5 x 1.46875)) = 2 sqrt(15) / 47 = 0.164808; step clamp(0.125, 0.125, 1.0) = 0.125, t 1.625. t 1.625 (z 2.125): h = 0.125 equals ph, not approaching. Beyond the plane every sample recedes (h 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 ...), so nothing else darkens. The hard hit never fires on this field because the nearest texel centres are 0.125 m from the plane, so the value is smoothstep(2 sqrt(15) / 47) = r^2 (3 - 2r) with r = 0.164808, which is 0.072532. The contract's 'blocked (0)' is not reachable with this field: see the handoff.

cases.name: empty volume
cases.why: No level: level_at returns levels.len() = 0 at the first sample, the walk breaks before any sample, res stays 1 and smoothstep(1) = 1.
